title: RGΦ: Exact rational radix–Möbius dynamics research compendium
description: Exact mathematical and computational research compendium for a noncommutative rational semigroup generated by an integer-radix transformation and a Möbius-conjugate branch. This pre-DOI release candidate includes the manuscript on robust nonnested extremal targets, exact threshold-robustness data, finite modular-trap classification evidence, exact-arithmetic software, regression tests, and reproducibility metadata.

creators.name: Firmenich, Facundo
